caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone charges through thin air! No cables needed, thanks to an invisible power field.

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Your phone and charging pad both have special wire coils inside.
🔹 The charging pad sends electricity through its coil, creating an invisible, pulsating magnetic field.
🔹 Your phone's coil 'catches' this magnetic field, converting it back into electricity.
🔹 This silent energy bridge powers up your battery without any physical connection! It's called Qi wireless charging.
